findings.impact: Session isolation is enforced at the backend broker boundary instead of relying on Flutter visibility.

findings.impact: Authenticated gateway upgrade, real topic delivery and denial through the running stack are not yet demonstrated.

findings.evidence: flutter build windows stopped before compilation because no suitable Visual Studio toolchain is installed.
findings.impact: The Dart dependency and source analyze successfully, but a Windows artifact cannot be produced on this machine.

decision: Keep the implementation commits. Do not mark Phase 8 complete until the runtime authorization matrix and Windows packaging are demonstrated.
